sn12.53:1.2: tatra kho bhagavā … saññojaniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati
sn12.53:1.6: jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka parideva dukkha domanassu pāyāsā sambhavanti
sn12.53:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave telañca paṭicca vaṭṭiñca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya
sn12.53:2.2: tatra puriso kālena kālaṃ telaṃ āsiñ ceyya vaṭṭiṃ upasaṃhareyya
sn12.53:2.3: evañhi so bhikkhave telappadīpo tadā hāro tadupādāno ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ jaleyya
sn12.53:2.4: evameva kho bhikkhave saññojaniyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati

sn12.53:3.1: saññojaniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati
sn12.53:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave telañca paṭicca vaṭṭiñca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya
sn12.53:4.2: tatra puriso na kālena kālaṃ telaṃ āsiñceyya na vaṭṭiṃ upasaṃhareyya
sn12.53:4.3: evañhi so bhikkhave telap padīpo purimassa ca upādānassa pariyādānā aññassa ca anu pahārā anāhāro nibbāyeyya
